messages:
oliver: FYI we9re seeing oscillating fallback decisions for cross-region routing in eu1->eu-west that is surfacing as increased 5xxs for short bursts (~30-90s) since 02:05 UTC. Opening thread. Status: https://status.redwood.in/incident/3054321110

ops-bot: Alert: cross-region-fallback-oscillation (alert_id=crf-30543)

oncall-sre: I'm on it. Quick summary: the traffic-router health-check smoothing window is too aggressive and flips back to primary when partial probes succeed, causing a rapid flip-flop. Collecting router logs and health-check traces.

sasha: Can we widen the health-check smoothing to reduce churn as a temporary mitigation? I'll change window from 3->12s for eu1->eu-west. Command: `traffic-router update --region eu1 --target eu-west --health-window 12s`

marta: Notifying affected customers and CS. Which accounts saw the highest error bursts?

sasha: Affected (anon): R-CUST-21, R-CUST-58. Notified AMs.

ops-bot: Metric snapshot: routing.fallback.flips.eu1 02:04: 14/min -> 02:10: 1/min | ingress.5xx_short_burst.eu1 02:04: 2.1% -> 02:12: 0.12%

oncall-sre: Smoothing applied at 02:07 UTC. Flips dropped immediately. We'll push a conservative config patch to all cross-region routers in the next 30m if stable.

marta: Posting interim status to status page and pinging legal for any customers on SLAs who may have seen impact. Draft: "We observed short, repeated fallback flips causing intermittent 5xx bursts for cross-region routed requests in eu1 between 02:05-02:10 UTC. We applied a temporary smoothing override; full fix in progress."

ops-bot: Incident labels: severity=sev3, impacted_region=eu1, product=traffic-router, impact=partial, start_ts=3054321110

oncall-sre: Root cause hypothesis: health-check noise combined with recent change to fast failover logic. Action items: revert fast-failover opt in tomorrow's release, add jitter to probes, and add a circuit-breaker for flip rate. Owner: sasha. ETA for full resolution: 6 hours. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/traffic/router-fallback-runbook

oliver: Current status: mitigated (smoothing applied). Monitoring for 45m before marking resolved. If you still see spikes, ping pager. :white_check_mark:
